mapper.insert: insert into cm_inbox_broadcasts ( id, staff_user_id, scope, tier, mode, template_code, locale, subject_type, payload_json, target_count, success_count, failure_count ) values ( #{id}, #{staffUserId}, #{scope}, #{tier}, #{mode}, #{templateCode}, #{locale}, #{subjectType}, #{payloadJson}, 0, 0, 0 )
mapper.update: update cm_inbox_broadcasts set target_count = #{targetCount}, success_count = #{successCount}, failure_count = #{failureCount}, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select b.id, b.staff_user_id as staffUserId, b.scope, b.tier, b.mode, b.template_code as templateCode, b.locale, b.subject_type as subjectType, b.payload_json as payloadJson, b.target_count as targetCount, b.success_count as successCount, b.failure_count as failureCount, b.created_at as createdAt, b.updated_at as updatedAt, u.user_name as staffUserName from cm_inbox_broadcasts b left join sys_user u on cast(u.user_id as char) = b.staff_user_id where b.id = #{id} limit 1

select t.id, t.user_id as userId, t.message_id as messageId, t.status, t.error_message as errorMessage, t.retry_count as retryCount, t.next_retry_at as nextRetryAt, t.created_at as createdAt, u.account_name as accountName from cm_inbox_broadcast_targets t left join cm_users u on u.id = t.user_id where t.broadcast_id = #{broadcastId} order by t.created_at desc, t.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into cm_inbox_single_dispatches ( id, staff_user_id, user_id, message_id, mode, template_code, locale, subject_type, subject_id, payload_json, status, error_message ) values ( #{id}, #{staffUserId}, #{userId}, null, #{mode}, #{templateCode}, #{locale}, #{subjectType}, #{subjectId}, #{payloadJson}, 'pending', null )
mapper.update: update cm_inbox_single_dispatches set message_id = #{messageId}, status = 'success', error_message = null, updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id}

update cm_inbox_single_dispatches set status = if(#{retryable}, 'retrying', 'failure'), error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_retry_at = if(#{retryable}, date_add(now(), interval 5 minute), null), updated_at = current_timestamp where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select d.id, d.staff_user_id as staffUserId, d.user_id as userId, d.message_id as messageId, d.mode, d.template_code as templateCode, d.locale, d.subject_type as subjectType, d.subject_id as subjectId, d.payload_json as payloadJson, d.status, d.error_message as errorMessage, d.retry_count as retryCount, d.next_retry_at as nextRetryAt, d.created_at as createdAt, d.updated_at as updatedAt, u.account_name as accountName, su.user_name as staffUserName, m.body as messageBody, m.message_type as messageType from cm_inbox_single_dispatches d left join cm_users u on u.id = d.user_id left join sys_user su on cast(su.user_id as char) = d.staff_user_id left join cm_inbox_messages m on m.id = d.message_id where d.id = #{id} limit 1

select t.id, t.broadcast_id as broadcastId, t.user_id as userId, b.staff_user_id as staffUserId, b.payload_json as payloadJson, u.preferred_locale as preferredLocale from cm_inbox_broadcast_targets t join cm_inbox_broadcasts b on b.id = t.broadcast_id join cm_users u on u.id = t.user_id where t.status = 'retrying' and t.retry_count < #{maxAttempts} and t.next_retry_at <= now() order by t.next_retry_at limit #{batchSize}
mapper.update: update cm_inbox_single_dispatches set retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_retry_at = date_add(now(), interval (#{baseDelayMinutes} * pow(2, least(retry_count, 10))) minute), status = if(retry_count >= #{maxAttempts}, 'exhausted', 'retrying') where id = #{id}
update cm_inbox_broadcast_targets set message_id = #{messageId}, status = 'success', error_message = null, next_retry_at = null where id = #{id}

update cm_inbox_broadcast_targets set retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_retry_at = date_add(now(), interval (#{baseDelayMinutes} * pow(2, least(retry_count, 10))) minute), status = if(retry_count >= #{maxAttempts}, 'exhausted', 'retrying') where id = #{id}

update cm_inbox_broadcasts b set success_count = (select count(*) from cm_inbox_broadcast_targets t where t.broadcast_id = b.id and t.status = 'success'), failure_count = (select count(*) from cm_inbox_broadcast_targets t where t.broadcast_id = b.id and t.status != 'success') where b.id = #{broadcastId}
mapper.select: select id from cm_inbox_messages where dedupe_key = #{dedupeKey} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cm_inbox_system_failures (id, user_id, template_code, variables_json, subject_id, dedupe_key, status, retry_count, next_retry_at, error_message) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{templateCode}, #{variablesJson}, #{subjectId}, #{dedupeKey}, #{status}, 0, if(#{retryable}, date_add(now(), interval 5 minute), null), #{errorMessage}) on duplicate key update error_message = values(error_message), updated_at = now()
mapper.update: update cm_inbox_system_failures set retry_count = retry_count + 1, error_message = #{errorMessage}, next_retry_at = date_add(now(), interval (#{baseDelayMinutes} * pow(2, least(retry_count, 10))) minute), status = if(retry_count >= #{maxAttempts}, 'exhausted', 'pending') where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from cm_inbox_messages where sender_type in ('staff', 'system')) as messageSuccessCount, (select count(*) from cm_inbox_single_dispatches where status in ('failure','retrying','exhausted')) + (select count(*) from cm_inbox_broadcast_targets where status in ('failure','retrying','exhausted')) + (select count(*) from cm_inbox_system_failures) as messageFailureCount, (select count(*) from cm_inbox_single_dispatches where status = 'retrying') + (select count(*) from cm_inbox_broadcast_targets where status = 'retrying') + (select count(*) from cm_inbox_system_failures where status = 'pending') as pendingRetryCount, (select count(*) from cm_inbox_single_dispatches where status = 'exhausted') + (select count(*) from cm_inbox_broadcast_targets where status = 'exhausted') + (select count(*) from cm_inbox_system_failures where status = 'exhausted') as exhaustedRetryCount, (select count(*) from cm_users where status = 'active') as activeUserCount, (select count(*) from cm_user_memberships where status = 'active') as activeMembershipCount, (select count(*) from cm_event_registrations where status = 'confirmed') as confirmedEventRegistrationCount
mapper.delete: delete from cm_inbox_system_failures where status in ('failure', 'exhausted') and updated_at < #{before} limit 500
delete from cm_translation_retries where status = 'exhausted' and updated_at < #{before} limit 500
delete from cm_user_security_challenges where status = 'expired' and updated_at < #{before} limit 500
delete from cm_security_events where created_at < #{before} limit 500
delete from sys_logininfor where login_time < #{before} limit 500
delete from sys_oper_log where oper_time < #{before} limit 500
delete from sys_job_log where create_time < #{before} limit 500
